note: Security World v13.9.0 release notes (revision 1.4, 2026-09-14) section 3.9: ML-DSA in the nShield PKCS #11 API with these mechanisms, parameter sets 44/65/87; needs firmware v13.8 or later and the PostQuantum feature enabled. The names are defined in the OASIS PKCS #11 v3.2 header (https://docs.oasis-open.org/pkcs11/pkcs11-spec/v3.2/os/include/pkcs11-v3.2/pkcs11t.h). Native nCore ML-DSA is listed from V13.7 (https://nshielddocs.entrust.com/app-notes/crypto-support/intro.html). CMVP certificate 4745 (nShield 5s Hardware Security Module, FIPS 140-3 level 3, active, updates through 2026-09-23) lists none of ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, LMS or XMSS in its approved or allowed algorithm lists (https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program/certificate/4745). Entrust says its post-quantum implementation is CAVP-validated (firmware v13.8.0, Sept 2025) but no certificate number was read from any page; A7285, named in older free text, is not confirmed. Whether the post-quantum algorithms run in FIPS-approved mode is not stated on the pages read.
